title: Signal Codes

scenario.intro: The Signal Tower answers every request with a three-digit code, and right now every answer is 500: the city thinks the tower is on fire.
scenario.goal: Set the three codes the tower sends back: a {{thing}} that exists, a {{thing}} that was just created, and a {{thing}} that doesn't exist.

objective: Every answer carries the status code that tells the truth.
rules: Found a {{thing}}: it worked, here is the data.
Created a new {{thing}}: a new thing exists now.
No such {{thing}}: that resource doesn't exist.

hints.text: Read the first digit: 2xx means it worked, 4xx means the client asked for something wrong.
"It worked" and "a new thing was created" are both 2xx, but not the same code. The briefing's table has both.
Something like: FOUND = 200, CREATED = 201, and a missing {{thing}} is the famous 4xx.

dialogue.start: Every answer says 500. The whole city thinks we crashed!
dialogue.success: Clear signals! Every tower knows exactly what happened.
dialogue.fail: Some answers still send the wrong signal. Check the codes in the log.
